title: 第493章 护法真人第492章 曾经往事
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：仙眼第一卷：风起九州第493章护法真人（..la）“原来如此……”
韩林恍然地点了点头，“请问，叶宗主可有具体的名单呢？”
叶南山道：“你要名单干什么，难道想一个个揪出来杀掉？”
“叶宗主误会了，韩某的心胸还没狭隘到要杀几个普通弟子来出气。归元宗虽然不仁，但韩某却并非不义，其实在归元宗，也有一些人是韩某颇为记挂的，我想知道，这些人如今是否还活着……”韩林摇摇头道。
“这样啊，倒是我误会韩道友了。”叶南山笑了笑，“不过我这里确实没有名单，如果你有想了解的，可以先告诉我，以后我帮你打听打听。”
“好，那就劳烦叶宗主，帮我打听一下这几个人吧，他们分别叫罗三、傅九、刘德柱、叶祁、方凝和洪涢，这些都是我的故友，若在玄道宗的话，还请叶宗主告诉我一声，我想跟他们聊聊。”韩林有些缅怀道。
叶南山想了想，脑海中确实没有这几个人的印象，点点头道：“行，我改天帮你问问，有消息再通知你。不过，我也有一个要求，希望你能够答应。”
“什么要求？”韩林道。
“你这次回来，应该是要和青锋贤侄一起参加神选计划的吧？”
“确有这个打算，只是碍于仙道盟的追杀令，仍在犹豫之中。”
“仙道盟追杀令你不必担心，我会帮你解决，但是有一个前提，就是你必须加入我们玄道宗。”
“加入玄道宗？”
“没错！我要你以玄道宗的名义，去参加神选计划。”叶南山点头道。
“这有什么区别吗？”韩林不解。
“当然有区别！”叶南山随即就给韩林三人讲解起神选计划的关键。
按照叶南山所言。
所谓神选计划，就是将八大宗门的资源全部集中起来，无条件提供给仙道盟仓库，进行统一调度。
各大派弟子和散修，都可以报名参加神选计划。
计划分两部分进行。
第一部分是神选大赛，也就是选拔人才阶段。届时将在九州设立多个擂台，进行层层筛选。

最终选出三千精英、三百将帅、三十六名道种、以及九大圣子。
每一次胜出，都能获得奖励！最终成功脱颖而出之人，其奖励更是丰厚至极。
而第二个部分，就是养神阶段。
在决出固定名额后，仙道盟的仓库，将只为这些脱颖而出之人敞开。
获得对应名额之人，可以通过各种任务赚取积分，快速提升自己实力。
相当于，只要你有积分，就能换到你想要的所有资源。
如果仙道盟仓库实在没你想要的，你直接说出来，到时仙道盟的元婴老祖，会亲自出去帮你寻找。
待遇高得吓人！
不过就目前来看，八大派提供的资源，已经涵盖了元婴期以下之人的正常需求。
也正因为如此，各大派都希望，自己拿出去的资源能够用在自家弟子身上，而不是被其他宗门，或者散修拿走。
如此的话，那就相当于，用自己的钱，帮别人培养强者了。
所以，叶南山才要求韩林加入玄道宗，以玄道宗的名义，参加神选计划。
在他看来，以韩林的年纪和境界修为，不说成为圣子，绝对是保精英、能争道种的存在。
“所以，现在你应该明白，我为何要你加入玄道宗了吧？”
“明白。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Fairy Eyes Volume 1: The Wind Rises in Kyushu Chapter 493 The Protector of the Law (..la) "So that's how it is..."
Han Lin nodded suddenly, "Excuse me, does Sect Leader Ye have a specific list?"
Ye Nanshan said: "Why do you want the list? Do you want to pick them out and kill them one by one?"
"Master Ye misunderstood. Han is not so narrow-minded that he wants to kill a few ordinary disciples to vent his anger. Although Guiyuan Sect is unkind, Han is not unjust. In fact, there are some people in Guiyuan Sect whom Han cares about. I want to know if these people are still alive now..." Han Lin shook his head.
"That's it. I misunderstood Fellow Daoist Han." Ye Nanshan smiled, "But I really don't have a list here. If you want to know anything, you can tell me first, and I will help you find out later."
"Okay, then please help me, Sect Master Ye, to find out about these people. Their names are Luo San, Fu Jiu, Liu Dezhu, Ye Qi, Fang Ning and Hong Wei. These are all my old friends. If you are in Xuan Dao Sect, please tell me, Sect Master Ye, I want to talk to them." Han Lin said with some nostalgia.
Ye Nanshan thought for a while and found that there was indeed no impression of these people in his mind. He nodded and said, "Okay, I'll ask you another day and let you know when I have news. However, I also have a request, which I hope you can agree to."
"What's the request?" Han Lin asked.
"When you come back this time, you should be participating in the God's Choice Project with your nephew Qingfeng, right?"
"We do have this plan, but we are still hesitating because of the Immortal Alliance's pursuit order."
"Don't worry about the Immortal Alliance's pursuit. I will help you solve it, but there is a prerequisite, that is, you must join our Xuan Dao Sect."
"Join Xuan Dao Sect?"
"That's right! I want you to participate in the Divine Selection Project in the name of Xuan Dao Sect." Ye Nanshan nodded.
"What's the difference?" Han Lin was puzzled.
"Of course there is a difference!" Ye Nanshan immediately explained the key to the God's Choice plan to Han Lin and the others.
According to what Ye Nanshan said.
The so-called Divine Selection Plan is to pool all the resources of the eight major sects and provide them unconditionally to the Immortal Alliance's warehouse for unified dispatch.
Disciples and casual cultivators from all major sects can sign up to participate in the Divine Selection Plan.
The plan is to proceed in two parts.
The first part is the Divine Selection Competition, which is the talent selection stage. At that time, multiple arenas will be set up in Kyushu to conduct layer-by-layer screening.
In the end, three thousand elites, three hundred generals, thirty-six Taoists, and nine saints were selected.
Every time you win, you will get a reward! The reward for those who succeed in standing out in the end will be extremely generous.
The second part is the resting stage.
After the fixed quota is determined, the warehouse of the Immortal Alliance will be opened only to these outstanding people.
Those who obtain the corresponding quota can earn points through various tasks and quickly improve their strength.
Equivalently, as long as you have points, you can exchange for all the resources you want.
If the Immortal League's warehouse really doesn't have what you want, you can just say so, and then the Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Immortal League will personally go out to help you find it.
The pay is frighteningly high!
However, for now, the resources provided by the eight major sects have covered the normal needs of people below the Nascent Soul stage.
Because of this, each major sect hopes that the resources they provide can be used on their own disciples instead of being taken away by other sects or casual cultivators.
If this is the case, it is equivalent to using your own money to help others cultivate strong people.
Therefore, Ye Nanshan asked Han Lin to join Xuandao Sect and participate in the Divine Selection Project in the name of Xuandao Sect.
In his opinion, with Han Lin's age and level of cultivation, not to mention becoming a saint, he is definitely an elite and capable of competing for Taoism.
"So, now you should understand why I want you to join Xuan Dao Sect, right?"
"Understood."
